sections.subhead: A CRM Built Around Your Actual Sales Process, Not a Generic Pipeline

body.text: Teknoppy builds custom CRM software in Kochi around how your sales team actually works — your stages, fields and follow-ups. We migrate your existing contacts, connect your website forms, WhatsApp Business API and email, and train your team. Most custom CRMs go live in 4-10 weeks.

Choosing the right CRM development partner in Kochi matters because software only creates value if your team actually uses it. A system that doesn't match how deals actually move through your pipeline gets abandoned within months — we build tools your team will rely on daily.

items.title: Custom CRM Software
items.text: Custom CRM software development builds a system around your specific sales stages, customer data structure, and team workflow, rather than forcing your process into a rigid template.

items.title: Sales & Lead Management
items.text: Lead management and sales tracking from first inquiry through closing, giving your team complete visibility into deal stages, pending quotes, and conversion rates.

items.title: Automation & Dashboards
items.html: Automated follow-up reminders, status triggers, and assignment rules reduce manual data entry. Paired with real-time analytics — explore our dashboard development services for custom BI.

items.title: Integration & Data Migration
items.html: Direct API connections for WhatsApp Business API, website forms, IndiaMART/JustDial leads, Gmail/Outlook, and Tally/ERP systems. Learn more about our API integration services.

sections.h2: Custom CRM or an Off-the-Shelf CRM?
sections.intro: We help you select the most cost-effective CRM path based on your team size and operational complexity:

items.title: Custom CRM Platform
items.text: Built 100% around your exact sales pipeline and custom fields. One-time build cost with zero recurring per-user licensing fees. You own all code and customer data.

items.title: Off-the-Shelf CRM
items.text: Platforms like Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce are quick to start but carry escalating monthly per-user licensing fees and lock your team into rigid third-party workflows.

items.title: CRM Configuration & Sync
items.text: If an off-the-shelf CRM fits your workflow, we configure custom pipelines, configure automation rules, and integrate your website forms seamlessly.

items.title: Sales Process Mapping (Week 1)
items.text: We document your real pipeline stages, required customer fields, and follow-up protocols before designing the system.

items.title: Custom Build & Configuration (Weeks 2-5)
items.text: Fields, pipelines, and roles are built and tested on a secure staging environment.

items.title: Automation Setup (Week 6)
items.text: Lead assignment rules, automated WhatsApp/email triggers, and reminder workflows are configured.

items.title: Integration & Migration (Weeks 7-8)
items.text: Historical customer records and contacts from spreadsheets or legacy software are cleaned, mapped, and migrated.

items.title: Training & Adoption (Weeks 9-10)
items.text: Live training for sales reps and managers, backed by 30 days of active post-launch adoption support.

items.q: How much does custom CRM development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Configuring an existing CRM typically costs between Rs. 35,000 and Rs. 75,000. A custom-built CRM with tailored pipelines, lead scoring, and automated reminders ranges from Rs. 85,000 to Rs. 3,50,000+ depending on team size and integrations. We provide an exact proposal after reviewing your sales process.

items.q: Do we pay per-user fees for a custom CRM?
items.a: No. When Teknoppy builds a custom CRM, you own the software and database outright. There are zero monthly per-user license fees, meaning your team can grow without escalating software costs.

items.q: Can the CRM capture leads from WhatsApp and our website automatically?
items.a: Yes. We integrate your website forms, landing pages, and the official WhatsApp Business API so every new enquiry enters the CRM instantly, assigns to a sales representative, and sends an automatic acknowledgment.

items.q: Can my sales team use the CRM on their smartphones?
items.a: Yes. The CRM is built responsive and cloud-hosted, allowing sales representatives in the field to update deal statuses, log call notes, and view client contact details on mobile browsers.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing customer data into a new CRM?
items.a: Yes. We clean, format, and migrate your contacts, past deal history, and notes from Excel spreadsheets, Google Sheets, or legacy software with zero data loss.

items.q: How long does a CRM development project take?
items.a: A custom CRM development project typically takes 4 to 10 weeks, encompassing sales process mapping, interface design, automation setup, data migration, and live user training.
